stories.title: Tigress and the Afternoon With No Plan
stories.outro: See you next time in Sunny Meadow!
stories.moral: A small idea of your own can begin a new game.
moralRhyme: Start with one small thing today,
See where your idea can play!

youtube.title: Tigress and the Afternoon With No Plan | Sunny Meadow
youtube.description: Tigress sighed at an afternoon with nothing planned. Rocky rested beside an empty little basket. A gentle friendship story. A small idea of your own can begin a new game. #SunnyMeadow #DreamyDiscoveries

lines.text: Tigress sighed at an afternoon with nothing planned.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Rocky rested beside an empty little basket.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: There is absolutely nothing interesting to do today.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: I have not planned an afternoon game either.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Tigress wanted a grand adventure before snack time.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: She searched the basket for something wonderfully exciting.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: This basket should contain a ready-made adventure.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: It seems to contain one leaf and some air.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Tigress took out the leaf and inspected it.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: It was small, green, and completely ordinary.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Perhaps the adventure is hiding underneath the leaf.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: There is definitely more air under that part.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Tigress asked Rocky to invent an enormous new game.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: He considered the quiet path beside their bench.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Could you invent an enormous new game instead?
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: I cannot think of an enormous one right now.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Does a new game need a brand-new toy?
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Tigress set the leaf on her knee and sighed.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: A soft breeze nudged its pointed little end.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Even this leaf seems bored with my knee!
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: A little breeze is sending it sliding away.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Tigress stopped it from sliding onto the ground.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: She balanced it on the basket's broad wooden handle.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Now it looks like a little green roof.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Perhaps someone needs a house under that roof.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Tigress placed a smooth pebble beneath the leaf.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Rocky watched the small house take shape.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: The pebble is a very round, very quiet guest.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: What sort of game does your guest enjoy?
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Tigress made a rule for delivering the pebble home.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: She carried it on the flat part of the leaf.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: One careful delivery without dropping our round guest.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: That leaf looks rather slippery for a moving van.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: The pebble rolled onto the grass beside her feet.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Tigress picked it up and studied the leaf.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: My moving van needs a gentler cornering rule.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: You could choose a shorter route to the basket.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: What can Tigress change in her own game?
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Tigress moved the basket closer and tried again.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: She kept the leaf level through one small turn.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Delivery complete! One pebble arriving at its green roof.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Your guest has reached home with all its roundness.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Rocky asked for a turn at the new delivery game.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Tigress explained the short route before handing it over.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: You may carry the leaf with both paws.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Then I shall be the careful afternoon delivery service.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: They invented a second home beside a smaller stone.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: The short route became a little neighborhood path.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: We could add a station where deliveries pause.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: And a rule that drivers take turns at the basket.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Tigress looked at the leaf that seemed ordinary before.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: It now had two homes and a delivery route.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: My adventure did not arrive already packed in here.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: You started it with that little roof idea.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Rocky pretended to knock on the pebble's leafy house.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Tigress answered in a very grand pebble voice.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Sorry, no more deliveries. The resident is having a nap.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: An excellent idea. Even pebbles need quiet afternoons.
lines.speaker: friend
